report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the installed inventory is enumerated from disk and from the client's own plugin listing (two independent signals); an overlap claim quotes both implementations
tests_required_verbatim: detector control: the enumerator must find a plugin known to be installed AND return nothing for a fabricated plugin name; a lister that reports everything as present is matching directory noise
